obs1000: The top surface is a dark warm-gray scorch with a soft AO-like darkening toward the fold base. Airbrushed in character, but quiet.

The perimeter edge band switches abruptly between mid-gray and black in rectangular segments: 1000-front (gray left segment, then darker segments), 1000-left (gray middle, black right), 1000-right (black run ending in a light-gray end tab). These per-face value switches are the main 'manufactured tab/miter' risk.
The prior tan exposed-edge sliver is not visible in any r5 standalone view. The edge now carries no cut-metal cue.
The black triangle in front, left and right is the underface of the high fold, consistent with an underface projection about 18 mm thick, not a solid wall. Accepted.

The single straight crisp hinge with no bend radius, together with the clipped octagonal corners, reads as cut and folded sheet stock more than torn armor. This is a retained geometry limit and does not justify reopening.

Grounding: the flat rest reads. Contact shadow is weak, and the floor shadow shows horizontal banding in 1000-top and 1000-rear-three-quarter, consistent with shadow-map aliasing (presentation, not asset).
